scenes.text: Day two. You gave him a yacht.
Yesterday, a whale spat him onto this island.
But the top comment had one rule.
Give him a yacht, that is chained to the island, so it can't leave.
He did not read the fine print.
And drives in circles around his own island.
So he stops trying to leave.
And for the first time, he has a roof, and dinner.
But tonight, something is circling the yacht.
Day three. What does he get next? One word.
